Jie Gao (高洁)
Google Scholar CV

I am currently a Malone Postdoc Fellow in Malone Center for Engineering in Healthcare & Department of Computer Science at The Johns Hopkins University, starting March 2025. I am mentored by an interdisciplinary team of NLP and HCI, including Mark Dredze, Ziang Xiao, and Chien-Ming Huang. My research interests include Human-AI Collaboration, AI for Social Science and AI for Software Engineering. More specifically, my research focuses on building, theorizing and evaluating AI innovative software/tools, particularly in qualitative analysis area.

New Works

I explored a few new topics last year, including 1) MindCoder, 2) the full extension of Human-LLM interaction modes, and 3) CodeMap, a tool designed for code understanding. In particular, one of our most excited works has provided a functional tool named MindCoder, which supports automated qualitative coding within 3–5 minutes. You can access it via mindcoder.ai.
